name: Chlorzoxazone

fda.text: Serious (including fatal) hepatocellular toxicity has been reported rarely in patients receiving chlorzoxazone. The mechanism is unknown but appears to be idiosyncratic and unpredictable. Factors predisposing patients to this rare event are not known. Patients should be instructed to report early signs and/or symptoms…

summary: Rare cases of serious liver damage, which can even lead to death, have occurred without warning in people taking chlorzoxazone [3]. Because it is unpredictable and the reasons behind it are unknown, patients are told to report early warning signs or symptoms right away [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model rather than human tests gave this drug a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M].
